items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: Oh yeah, I knew Bunk, sure... He'd come and cook red beans and stuff like that, and Bunk would stay there all day with that horn.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I knew Bunk, sure. You know Bunk, sure, my brother plenty of it. And you know what he used to teach him for? A 10 cent bottle of wine. That's all. Did Bunk drink? Yeah, he'd drink wine. He was a wine drinker. He was one of the finest men I ever seen, man. He'd come and cook red beans and stuff like that, and Bunk would stay there all day with that horn. But boy, you know Bunk made some nice stuff on the horn? Played some nice horn. Up Johnson.
So he taught your brother wine, huh?
